title: FBI-UAP-D014, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-1, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering and narrative statement created by the FBI in 2026 based on a first-hand account of a UAP event from October 2023.

incidents.summary: A large glowing orange-red circular object and three smaller red lights observed over a desert landscape near a sensitive national security site.
incidents.quote: large, glowing orange-red circular object resembling a blood moon
